end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, Pongal, and Uttarayan in relation to harvest festivals.
Explained that a crop is a plant grown for food and harvest is when it is gathered.
Kavya identified January from “mid-January” and connected Uttarayan foods with the festival.
Lesson ended when Kavya asked to stop; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying festival foods, dates, and the idea of harvest festivals with Kavya. Kavya connected Uttarayan with chikki and til laddoos, and identified January from “mid-January.” The meaning of “harvest” and “new rice” was still being explored when Kavya asked to stop. At home, you can ask Kavya to name one festival food and whether it is linked to a crop being gathered.
